business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Oversized Furniture and Home Decor

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Government of the French Republic and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments, signed 20 March 2007 and in force from 20 August 2010, subject to its terms and applicable EU law

France-China Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital, signed 30 January 2019 and in force from 30 December 2020
France-EU trade and investment instruments applicable through European Union law
Other bilateral tax treaties and investment treaties may apply depending on the investor's residence, ownership chain, income source, and treaty entitlement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-1 et seq. and R.561-1 et seq.; beneficial-owner identification and filing requirements principally under Articles L.561-46 to L.561-50 and R.561-1 to R.561-3-0; Decree No. 2017-1094 of 12 June 2017 concerning the beneficial-owner register; Commercial Code provisions governing the National Register of Enterprises (Registre national des entreprises, RNE), maintained through the INPI single window. The beneficial-owner filing is not a substitute for customer due diligence, ownership-chain verification, or control-person analysis.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent identity authority in the country of issuance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, depending on the issuing country's treaty status with France; certified French translation generally required where the document is not in French

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation or commercial registry extract of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by certified French translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Current articles of association or constitutional instrument of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry, notary, or competent corporate authority in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by certified French translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Shareholder register, ownership certificate, or equivalent evidence identifying direct and indirect ownership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary, registry, notary, or competent corporate authority in the relevant country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by certified French translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized representative, corporate registry, notary, or competent authority, depending on origin-country requirements
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signature certification, Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization where requested by the French registrar, followed by certified French translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incumbency, power of attorney, or board authorization for the incorporation representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary, notary, registry, or competent corporate authority in the relevant country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by certified French translation where required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered office or domicile of each relevant individual and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, governmental authority, or other accepted issuing institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Ordinary documentary evidence is usually sufficient; apostille or consular legalization may be requested for foreign documents presenting heightened verification risk

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Screen all beneficial owners, directors, managers, authorized signatories, corporate shareholders, and material counterparties before incorporation and periodically thereafter against United Nations Security Council sanctions, European Union financial sanctions, French national sanctions, OFAC sanctions where relevant to the transaction or nexus, and reputable PEP and adverse-media databases. Apply enhanced due diligence to PEPs, relatives, and known close associates under the Monetary and Financial Code. Document identity resolution, false-positive clearance, source of wealth, source of funds, ownership control, sanctions rationale, and escalation decisions. Do not treat an OFAC listing as independently binding on a France-only transaction without a relevant United States nexus, but assess contractual, banking, payment-rail, and secondary-sanctions exposure. Stripe and Affirm may impose broader contractual screening and onboarding requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI): https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; company-name and trademark searches should also be conducted through the INPI databases, Registre national des entreprises, Registre national du commerce et des sociétés, and EUIPO databases
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be included in the French constitutional documents and filing. French does not generally require a corporate name to be in French, but the name must be sufficiently distinctive, not misleading, and compatible with public order and applicable sector regulation. Use of non-Latin characters, transliterations, translations, or accented characters should be checked against INPI filing functionality and registry acceptance. The company name must not infringe prior company names, trade names, trademarks, domain names, or protected geographical indications.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: words implying a regulated public authority or governmental status
Any term whose use is reserved, regulated, misleading, or likely to create confusion with a public body, regulated profession, financial institution, or existing protected business identifier
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France does not generally provide a universal statutory 30-day name-reservation mechanism for a SARL. Treat 30 days as an internal transaction hold only, not as a legally protected reservation period. Conduct INPI, RNE, trademark, domain, and commercial-name searches; obtain written clearance where a regulated or sensitive term is proposed; file the incorporation through the INPI single window; and correct any deficiency within the deadline stated in the registrar's notice. A rejection based on an incomplete or defective filing should first be remedied by resubmission or supplemental documents. A substantive refusal by the competent registry may be challenged before the competent commercial court or other legally designated court under the applicable Commercial Code procedure, subject to the notice's deadline and procedural instructions. No appeal should be filed solely against a third-party trademark objection without separate intellectual-property analysis.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A French SARL must have a declared registered office in France. Domiciliation with a commercial domiciliation company is generally permissible if the provider is authorized and the statutory requirements are satisfied. A director's home may be used subject to applicable residential, lease, condominium, zoning, and local restrictions. A bare mailbox is inadequate. For oversized-furniture e-commerce, the registered office may be separate from the warehouse, fulfillment location, showroom, customer returns address, and logistics premises. The company should maintain accessible corporate records, accounting records, customer-service capability, VAT and customs documentation, product-compliance files, and evidence of operational control. A virtual office does not eliminate consumer-law, product-safety, packaging, environmental, VAT, customs, or employment obligations.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No official public statistical probability is published for routine inspections of newly incorporated SARLs. A planning estimate for a straightforward, low-risk e-commerce applicant is below 5% during the first 12 months for an unannounced general corporate-site inspection, but this is not a legal safe harbor or official statistic. Risk may materially increase where there is a foreign ownership chain, inconsistent UBO data, high refund activity, customs or VAT anomalies, regulated-product claims, consumer complaints, sanctions indicators, warehouse or labor issues, or a domiciliation address serving unusually many entities. Customs, tax, labor, consumer-protection, product-safety, and financial-intelligence authorities may inspect different premises or records.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Code de commerce, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL); Articles R.123-30 et seq. (RCS registration); Décret n°2007-431 on legal formalities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique operated by INPI, transmitting to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for inscription on the Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts constitutifs (articles of association) filed with the standard business creation application through the INPI Guichet unique
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum SARL capital. Cash contributions must be at least 20% paid-up at incorporation, with the balance payable within five years; in-kind contributions must be fully paid-up at incorporation. Capital funds must be deposited with a bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations until RCS registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the undersigned associates, acting pursuant to the French Code de commerce and the draft articles of association, hereby (1) approve the subscription of the total share capital of [€X], allocated to the subscribing associates as set forth in the capital subscription schedule; (2) adopt the registered office located at [address] as the company's statutory seat and legal domicile; (3) appoint [Name] as Gérant, with full powers to operate the company, open bank accounts, and represent the company; and (4) authorize the Gérant to complete all registration formalities before the RCS/INPI Guichet unique, sign the attestations, and arrange publication of the required legal notice. This resolution takes effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-formation name check and statutory drafting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI data repository and Infogreffe/RCS records; French avocat or legal formateur
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the proposed corporate name is not already used by an existing RCS company or protected by a trademark. Draft the statuts in French with the mandatory legal terms: société à responsabilité limitée, corporate purpose corresponding to online retail and logistics of oversized home furniture, share capital, registered office, gérant powers, duration, and fiscal options. For cash-only formation, private signatures are sufficient; notarization is required only for contributions of real estate.
required_dossiers: Address details of the proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or clauses are flagged by the registry or INPI, amend the draft and resubmit the corrected statuts before signature; no pre-emptive official name reservation is available.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of capital deposit and bank attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, notary, or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked corporate account in the SARL's formation name and complete bank KYC. Each associate transfers or pays the cash contribution, and the depositary issues a capital blocking attestation (attestation de dépôt des fonds) stating the amount and the blocked account. Release of funds occurs only upon production of the RCS Kbis extract.
required_dossiers: Cash contribution proof or wire confirmations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen bank refuses the file, open the deposit with another bank or with a notaire; amend the bank attestation and restart the deposit procedure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Signature of statutes and gérant acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All associates and the appointed gérant; optional notaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Organize signature of the final French statuts by every associate or an authorized agent holding a power of attorney. The gérant signs separately the acceptance of office. Prepare an extract confirming share subscription, registered office adoption, and gérant appointment in accordance with the pro-forma first board resolution.
required_dossiers: Final statuts signed by all associates
Share subscription acts for each associate
Power of attorney if signature is made by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For omissions or defective signatures, execute a rectificatif or amended statutes and obtain fresh signatures; notarization may be required if real estate contributions were not fully described.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of legal notice in an authorized annonces légales gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and submit for publication a legal notice containing the proposed company name, legal form, share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, gérant details, and city of the RCS. Pay the gazette's tariff and obtain the attestation de parution, which is mandatory for the registration file.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed or the gazette refuses the notice, file a corrected notice or use another authorized gazette; retain the new attestation with a dated stamp.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: INPI Guichet unique filing and RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); RCS registrar at the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online official creation application, select legal form SARL, populate the company profile, attach all mandatory documents, pay the official fees, and submit. The Guichet unique transmits the dossier to the competent commercial court greffe. Review the pending status, respond to any observations via the portal, and download the Kbis extract upon acceptance, together with SIREN/SIRET and VAT registration data.
required_dossiers: Attestation de parution from the JAL
Domiciliation agreement if the registered office is not owned
Identity document and nationality declaration of the gérant
Acknowledged declaration of no criminal disqualification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a rejection or query, use the Guichet unique's follow-up application to provide supplementary documents within the prescribed deadline; if the refusal is maintained, appeal to the supervising judge (juge commis à la surveillance du registre) or the commercial court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE; DREETS/DDETS labour inspectorate; DREAL for environmental thresholds; commercial court registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Kbis issuance, verify that INSEE automatically allocates SIREN/SIRET and that the Guichet unique notifies the tax and social administrations. Open or retain a commercial bank account, review whether warehouse storage size triggers an ICPE declaration under the Code de l'environnement, and register VAT intra-community status if cross-border trade occurs. For online retail of furniture, no shop-operating licence is required.
required_dossiers: Employer liability register when first employee is hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIREN data or VAT registration is delayed, request correction through the Guichet unique's rectification function; for warehouse thresholds, file an ICPE declaration with the DREAL and obtain the receipt if the surface area exceeds applicable limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial manufacturing authorization required for ISIC 4791 online retail; DREAL is the competent authority if covered warehouse storage triggers an ICPE declaration; DREETS/DDETS oversees workplace compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - no sectoral operating or manufacturing permit is required for internet retail of oversized home furniture

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL / Ministry of Ecological Transition - ICPE registry
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - pure online retail without manufacturing is outside the EIA listing; a covered warehouse may require an ICPE 'Declaration' if the surface area exceeds 500 m², otherwise no EIA report is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply to furniture retail operations. If an ICPE declaration is required, comply with the applicable ministerial order for fire load, packaged waste storage, and separate collection of cardboard and wood. General waste handling must follow Code de l'environnement Articles L.541-1 et seq.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No formal fire brigade clearance is required for a non-public warehouse, but the building must comply with Code du travail workplace safety rules: fire doors, emergency exits, portable extinguishers, first-aid equipment, electrical installation conformity, and structural load certification from the building owner. If the premises are open to the public as an ERP, a municipal fire safety authorization may be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; business registration through Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises (INSEE issues SIREN/SIRET); VAT individual number issued by DGFiP or MSA
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities with a French permanent establishment must apply for a SIRET number using the formalities portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and then obtain a VAT individual number (FR + 11 digits and a two-digit key) from DGFiP. Non-established foreign persons selling goods to France may apply directly to the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) for a French intra-EU VAT number, filing form 1573-SD and providing proof of establishment, identity and business activity. The SARL domestic procedure is identical: statutory incorporation, CFE/guichet registration, INSEE issuance of SIREN/SIRET, then automatic VAT registration unless eligible for the micro-BA franchise.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: SARL is default subject to French corporate income tax (IS). Small closely-held SARLs may elect, under Article 239 bis AA CGI, to be taxed as partnerships (impôt sur le revenu) for a renewable maximum of five years. No US-style check-the-box classification election is available for French SARLs; hybrid mismatch restrictions under French transposition of ATAD (Law No. 2019-1479) apply to deny deductions for disregarded hybrid arrangements.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No registration threshold for foreign non-established suppliers (first euro of French taxable supplies). Domestic SARL may benefit from the franchise en base de TVA (zero VAT return obligation) up to EUR 91,900 annual turnover for goods online resale; beyond that mandatory VAT registration. EU distance-selling pan-European threshold for non-established EU merchants is EUR 10,000 (across all cross-border distance sales).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France has phased mandatory B2B e-invoicing and e-reporting reform (reforme de la facturation électronique). Receipt of e-invoices becomes compulsory from 1 September 2026 and e-emission from 1 September 2027. Invoices must be transmitted through registered Dematerialization Platforms (PDP) connected to the Public Invoice Portal (PPF), in CII, UBL or Factur-X formats. Export sales must be backed by customs exit data and are subject to e-reporting of counterpart data, but do not require on-invoice digital fiscal stamping because France has not adopted a real-time transaction clearance regime such as continuous taxation control.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Sales of movable goods physically dispatched or transported outside France or the EU qualify for 0% TVA provided title passes to the purchaser and the exporter obtains proof of the effective exit within 90 days from the time of dispatch (Article 262-I-1 CGI). Services ancillary to export (freight, handling, transport, packing) are zero-rated under Article 262-I-2 CGI. Other B2B services to taxable customers abroad are generally outside the scope of French VAT rather than zero-rated if the place of supply is the customer's member state. No zero-rating is allowed without documentary proof of the export or cross-border transport; the online supply platform (marketplace) may be deemed seller for VAT purposes under the deemed supplier rules for imports below the consignment threshold.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAE) filed via DELTA-SIC and validated by French customs with exit confirmation or MRN (Movement Reference Number)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing shipment to the foreign destination
Commercial invoice with export VAT rate 0% and the seller's French VAT identification number
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or bank/payment-provider record proving foreign receipt of consideration
Transport contract, delivery note or warehouse receipt proving physical carriage outside the European Union
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP and French Customs (Direction Générale des Douanes) may audit export transactions retrospectively. If the exporter fails to substantiate the physical exit, 0% treatment is reversed, the normal French VAT is clawed back, and the taxpayer faces a 40% deliberate under-declaration penalty (80% for procedural abuse/fraud), monthly late-payment interest of 0.20% (Article 1727-1728 CGI), plus possible criminal customs penalties up to EUR 500,000 and five years imprisonment under the French Customs Code for false customs declarations. For the SARL and its managers, civil tax liability for directors may also arise in fraud cases.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting with the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) and the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) as the prudential and exchange-policy authorities of the French Republic within the Eurosystem.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full current-account and capital-account convertibility. As a euro-area member applying Articles 63-66 TFEU, France maintains no exchange controls on current operations, foreign direct investment, profit repatriation, or cross-border payment flows; non-EU/EEA transactions are equally liberalized, subject only to (i) mandatory balance-of-payments statistical reporting by the resident bank to the Banque de France, (ii) foreign-investment prior authorization in narrowly defined sensitive sectors (not applicable to home-furniture e-commerce), and (iii) residual financial-sanctions and FATF-based screening. Profit remittance is unrestricted at the exchange-control level; the nominal hurdle is fiscal only, with statutory WHT of 30% on non-treaty outbound dividends, reducible to 25% under most tax treaties or 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying EU/EEA corporate shareholders.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. France imposes no surrender, forced conversion, or repatriation timeline on export proceeds; the mandatory conversion ratio is zero and a French SARL may freely hold EUR or any foreign currency in authorized French bank accounts. Cross-border receipts are, however, captured by the resident bank in the Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting framework (monthly reporting obligation lies on the bank, not the enterprise).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. (via LCL for mid-cap treasury)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rated MEDIUM for operational treasury and LOW for statutory share-capital escrow and documentary trade finance. ACPR-licensed French EMIs and neobanks (Qonto, Shine) permit fully remote SARL onboarding, provide French IBANs and PSP-friendly settlement, and are suitable auxiliary clearing accounts; EEA-passported offshore EMIs (Revolut Business via Lithuanian banking licence, Wise Business via Belgian EMI) operate lawfully in France under Directive 2009/110/EC passporting rules, but are treated only as secondary clearing rails, never as the sole treasury account, because marketplace/BNPL float concentration and non-resident manager structures may trigger abrupt account freezes. A tier-1 bank remains legally and practically mandatory for the SARL capital deposit certificate, FX forwards, commercial letters of credit, and large warehouse disbursements. Post-Brexit UK EMIs require a French registered agent and additional ACPR confirmations where they do not hold an EEA passport.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At tier-1 banks (BNP Paribas, Société Générale) the legal representative (gérant) is normally required to attend an in-person KYC interview at a French branch; remote video onboarding is accepted only via the banks' digital subsidiary channels (e.g., BNP Hello and Société Générale entity onboarding portal) or ACPR/EEA EMIs. Where the gérant is a non-EEA tax resident, French branch practice commonly requires (i) a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, (ii) original passport with apostille, and (iii) a notarial video-commissioning session or physical appearance at opening. The recommended path is to open the SARL capital escrow at a tier-1 bank to obtain the depositary certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds), maintain a tier-1 operational account for trade-FX services, and hold a secondary EMI account for marketplace collections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex UBO chain or opaque source of funds for the SARL's capital and subsequent liquidity injections.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO declaration per Article L.561-2-2 CMF; RNE/Kbis extract; articles of association; organisational chart; certified ID/passport of all natural persons with >25% ownership; previous six months of bank statements and tax returns for source-of-wealth; notarized source-of-funds declaration; signed capital subscription minutes and capital-increase resolutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming settlement floats from PSP and BNPL aggregators (Stripe, Affirm) carrying chargeback exposure, classified by the bank as third-party payment-transmission risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PSP merchant agreements; merchant IDs and settlement calendars; PCI-DSS attestation; e-commerce store terms and refund policy; chargeback and dispute logs; order-to-settlement reconciliation reports; French SIREN and VAT registration excerpts confirming legal activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurrent outbound wires to Chinese furniture suppliers representing a material share of gross turnover, raising trade-based money-laundering and mis-invoicing red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master supply agreement and purchase orders; Chinese supplier business-license certificate; French customs entry declarations (DAU); ocean/air bills of lading and packing lists; commercial invoices; transfer-pricing benchmark memo; warehouse logistics contracts and inventory reports.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low physical substance: remotely managed SARL with no brick-and-mortar retail presence and limited local payroll.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial lease or warehouse lease in France; payroll and social-security filings; manager's French residence or business-visa evidence; utility and civic invoices; operational website contracts; supplier and delivery contracts; French VAT and corporate-tax registration confirmations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All foreign capital contributions must be routed via SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA for EEA investors) to an ACPR-authorized bank holding the French operational account; the receiving bank automatically records the operation in the Banque de France balance-of-payments statement. The SWIFT purpose code should reference the capital nature of the payment, typically CAPT (capital transfer for participation in capital) or the bank-designated code for capital increases, with the French SIREN number and exact EUR amount in the additional information field. Where the injection is denominated in CNY or USD, the French bank converts into EUR on the client's spot instruction at the ECB reference rate plus European Banking Federation spread. Supporting documents include the shareholder capital-increase resolution, subscription minutes, and notarized affidavit of source of funds. No French central-bank approval is required for non-sensitive retail e-commerce, but the Banque de France direct-investment statistical declaration obligation applies to non-EEA investors and is executed by the bank; the French FDI screening mechanism under Article L151-3 CMF is not triggered because online furniture retail is outside the regulated sensitive sectors.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Preferred clearing rails: (i) SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) and SEPA Instant for EU/EEA suppliers using standard IBAN/BIC and contract references; (ii) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer for Chinese and third-country suppliers using full 12-digit CNAPS bank code and purpose code for trade payment for goods, with reference to the underlying sales contract and customs declaration; (iii) irrevocable documentary Letter of Credit under UCP 600 (SWIFT MT700/MT707) for large furniture container shipments, requiring bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, insurance certificate, and pre-shipment inspection certificate, recommended where the purchase order exceeds EUR 50,000; (iv) SEPA Direct Debit with creditor identifier for recurring French fixed charges such as rent and utilities; (v) daily sweeps of PSP and BNPL settlement floats into the tier-1 treasury account before net outward funding. Treasury discipline requires three-way invoice matching (purchase order, goods receipt, invoice), weekly bank reconciliation, and caps on non-trade-related FX payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/CNH deliverable outright forwards (offshore renminbi) under an ISDA 2002 master agreement
EUR/USD outright forwards and FX swaps for transactional cash-flow hedging
EUR/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) where onshore CNY deliverability is unavailable, permitted only as hedges of genuine commercial exposure
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for matching EUR-denominated financing against CNY/USD revenue streams
Plain-vanilla FX options (call and put spreads) under the AMF professional-client classification
Exchange-traded FX futures and cleared forwards through EU CCPs for eligible corporate treasury accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts approval and filing (dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the Guichet Unique / INPI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the fiscal year-end; for a December 31 year-end, no later than June 30.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered injunction with daily penalty (astreinte); SARL managers may face criminal fines up to EUR 9,000 for persistent non-filing; underlying public-ministry request may lead to judicial winding-up or strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporation tax return (déclaration de résultats, Form 2065-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For December 31 year-end, by the second working day after May 1 of the following year; for other fiscal years, by the second working day after the first day of the fourth month following the year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-filing penalty, increased to 40% after formal notice; monthly late-payment interest at 0.20%; no direct administrative strike-off but continued non-compliance may trigger tax lien and enforced collection.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration / annual UBO register validation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: INPI via the Guichet Unique / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following any change of beneficial ownership; if unchanged, the registered UBO details must remain accurate in the company file and are reviewed at the annual accounts approval event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or false UBO data may attract fines up to EUR 7,500 per legal person and up to six months' imprisonment for responsible managers; registry may reject subsequent filings until corrected.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business tax payment and liquidation (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises – CFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Advance notice issued in November; final payment due December 15 of the tax year; companies with CFE exceeding EUR 3,000 pay staged instalments in June and December.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% plus monthly enforcement interest; compulsory seizure may be initiated for amounts unpaid after formal demand; not linked to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) when it exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds at the fiscal year-end: total balance-sheet assets above EUR 4,000,000; annual turnover excluding tax above EUR 8,000,000; average workforce above 50 employees. Mandatory audit may also be imposed by the articles of association or on request of the shareholders' meeting.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) under the French Commercial Code; IFRS are permitted for consolidated financial statements and for entities included in IFRS consolidated accounts; eligible micro-entities may apply simplified French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no standalone annual UBO paper filing in France, but the SARL manager must keep the statutory registers current. Each share transfer affecting beneficial ownership must be notified to the registry within 30 days; the annual shareholders' meeting approving the accounts is the appropriate annual checkpoint to reconcile the register of share movements, confirm the accuracy of UBO data, and ensure any transfer documentation and RCS disclosures are completed within the legal one-month registration period.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shares and share movements (registre des mouvements de titres)
Shareholders' decision and general meeting minute book (registre des décisions des associés)
Manager decision record / managers' minutes book (registre des décisions de gérance)
Register of regulated-party agreements (registre des conventions réglementées)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 1,500 per annum for registered office or corporate agent domiciliation services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 12,000 for a statutory audit of a small-to-medium SARL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs; 3.3% social surcharge above €763,000 IS; accelerated depreciation; innovation grants
